title: Tenant profile capture
description: Capture tenant name, phone, photo, ID proof photo, emergency contact name/phone.
acceptanceCriteria: Photo and ID proof photo are captured via camera or gallery and stored locally
All fields are editable after creation

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting. Tenant has no bed/room reference at the schema level (that link lives on TenancyAgreement, LODGY-12/13's job), so profile capture is genuinely standalone - building it that way. Also building the Tenant directory list (Tenants tab) and a basic profile view screen, since neither exists anywhere else in the backlog and there's no path to a tenant's profile without them; LODGY-31 will add the quick-contact buttons onto the profile view this creates.

Built media/PhotoStorage.kt (creates a FileProvider camera-output Uri in cacheDir, persists any picked/captured image into filesDir/photos/<uuid>.jpg on IO dispatcher - satisfies DESIGN.md's app-private-storage requirement), ui/tenant/PhotoPickerField.kt (reusable: 'Take Photo' launches the system camera via ActivityResultContracts.TakePicture into a FileProvider Uri, 'Choose Photo' launches the Android Photo Picker via PickVisualMedia - neither needs a runtime permission), data/repository/TenantRepository.kt, and the full Tenant flow: TenantDirectoryScreen (search + list, wired as the Tenants tab), TenantFormScreen (photo + ID proof pickers, name/phone/emergency contact, shared add/edit), TenantProfileScreen (view + edit entry point for LODGY-31 to extend). Added coil3 (coil-compose) for image loading since AsyncImage from a file path is needed in three places now and will be needed again for notes photos later. Manifest: added a FileProvider + res/xml/file_paths.xml for the camera Uri. Bug caught before shipping: TenantProfileViewModel originally fetched the tenant once with getById, which would go stale after editing since popping back to a retained NavBackStackEntry doesn't re-run init - added TenantDao.getByIdFlow/TenantRepository.observeById and switched to that instead. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Not yet exercised on-device (camera/gallery flows especially need real interaction, not just a code read) - still queued behind the slow emulator boot, now well over an hour.
